name: 3270 Logon Panel
note: Green-screen sign-on map. Protected labels in turquoise, unprotected fields in intensified white with underscore fill; the caret types USERID, masked PASSWORD and APPLID in turn, then the OIA raises X SYSTEM. Loops.
html:
VM/ESA ONLINE NODE SYSA
SIGN ON — TYPE USERID AND PASSWORD
USERID ===> █__________
PASSWD ===> █__________
APPLID ===> █________
PF1HELPPF3QUITPF12CNCL

name: CICS Transaction Screen
note: CICS map with terminal/operator header, protected labels and unprotected entry fields. On each cycle the keyboard locks (X SYSTEM with a spinning clock), the map dims, then the DFH response line reports the posting.

name: PF Key Legend Bar
note: Twelve-key PF legend. A highlight sweeps the keys and reports each action on the line below; hover or click a key to take over the selection, and the key flashes reverse-video as if pressed.

name: Field Validation Error Line
note: The full 3270 error ritual: a bad numeric field is keyed, ENTER locks the keyboard (X -f), the field flips to reverse-video red and the IKJ message types onto the message line, then RESET, retype and accept.
html:
BK04 CREDIT LIMIT UPDATE SYSA
ACCOUNT===>004821-77
LIMIT===>█__________
EFFECT===>2026-09-01
4▮A 07/029

name: Job Submission Confirmation
note: TSO SUBMIT console. The command types itself, then IKJ/HASP responses stream in one line at a time, the elapsed clock runs and the job ends with RC=0000 above a blinking three-asterisk prompt.
html:
TSO SUBMIT SYSA · JES2
***█
